script: o=$(mktemp); kind(){ line=; read -r line < "$o"; case $line in "["*) echo full;; "") echo none;; *) echo pid;; esac; }; d=$(mktemp -d); mkfifo "$d/a" "$d/b"; /bin/sh -c 'read x < "$0"' "$d/a" | /bin/sh -c 'read x < "$0"' "$d/b" & jobs -p > "$o"; read -r first < "$o"; jobs >/dev/null; jobs -n > "$o"; kind; echo go > "$d/a"; /bin/sh -c 'until [ ! -e "/proc/$1" ] || [ "$(cut -d " " -f 3 "/proc/$1/stat" 2>/dev/null)" = Z ]; do :; done' sh "$first"; jobs -n > "$o"; kind; echo go > "$d/b"; wait; rm -rf "$d" "$o"
